label.purpose: Stat captions, nav pill text, badges.

shadows.name: card-float
shadows.purpose: Lifts the floating glass-card stat overlay off a dark background.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover/focus state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid magenta pill CTA, uppercase + arrow in marketing contexts.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #D71284; color: #fff; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; border: none; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #B80E6F; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D71284; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent secondary button, ink border on light backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #0A0A0A; border: 2px solid #0A0A0A; padding: 12px 30px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(10,10,10,0.06); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0A0A0A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pill Nav Item
components.css: .ds-pill-nav { background: #F3F4F6; color: #0A0A0A; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 500; border: none; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-pill-nav:hover { background: #E2E5E9; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Floating white stat overlay over a dark mockup background.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: #fff; color: #0A0A0A; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(18,2,18,0.18); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: fit-content; } .ds-glass-card-value { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-glass-card-label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #6B7280; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Colored dot + label, maps to item pipeline status. Each of the 7 ItemStatus values gets its own color; only 'listed' uses Signal Magenta.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0A0A0A; } .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #D71284; }

components.name: Stat Block
components.description: Large bold number over a small gray caption, no border.
components.css: .ds-stat-block { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-stat-value { font-weight: 800; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.1; color: #0A0A0A; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #6B7280; margin-top: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A dark, secure, premium-handling backdrop -- near-black sections with a maroon undertone, like a vault door -- with a single vivid magenta signal used sparingly for value and action: primary CTAs, live-status dots, gradient accents on the one phrase that matters in a headline. The system reads confident and clean, not playful or bouncy; motion should stay restrained. Extracted from three reference screenshots of copyt.io (login, dark hero, light hero) -- colors and type are visual estimates from those images, not pixel-sampled, and should be re-verified against the live site or exact design files before shipping publicly. Concierge inherits Copyt's existing brand system wholesale rather than establishing its own -- it's an extension of the same product, not a rebrand.
keyCharacteristics: Magenta-on-dark / magenta-on-white duality as the strongest, most consistent brand signal across every surface seen
Pill-shaped (fully rounded) buttons and nav elements everywhere -- no sharp-cornered interactive controls
A second, larger-radius "card" shape reserved for floating stat/glass-card overlays, distinct from the pill radius
Heavy-weight grotesk display type, restrained body copy
Sparse, purposeful motion -- confidence over delight

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Magenta means "act here" or "this is live." It never appears as decorative fill on static content -- only on CTAs, links, active/live states, and headline emphasis. Of the 7 item pipeline statuses, only 'listed' gets magenta, because that is the one status that is actually live.

rules.name: The Casing Split Rule
rules.body: Sentence case is the default for headlines and body copy. Full uppercase is reserved for nav items, arrow-suffixed marketing CTAs, and stat/label captions only -- never for paragraph copy.

rules.name: The Two-Radius Rule
rules.body: If it's clickable, it's a full pill. If it's a content container, it's a 16px card. No other radius values.

dos: Do keep every interactive control fully rounded (rounded-full) -- no sharp-cornered buttons, inputs-as-buttons, or nav items.
Do ration magenta to CTAs, live/active states, and headline emphasis only.
Do use sentence case as the default text casing; uppercase only for nav, arrow-CTAs, and label/caption text.
Do reuse the glass-card-over-dark-mockup pattern for anything showing a "live system" metric (item counts, profit totals, sync status).
donts: Don't use the 16px card radius on anything clickable -- cards are for content containment, pills are for interaction.
Don't add shadows to flat in-page-flow sections; shadows are reserved for the floating glass-card pattern only.

Don't treat the hex values in this file as pixel-exact -- no color-sampling tool was available when this was authored; re-verify against the live site or design files before using them in anything customer-facing beyond this MVP.
